description: This file contains utility functions related to form handling in the SuiteCRM application, specifically for campaign tracking modules. It includes functions for generating JavaScript validation scripts and creating HTML forms for new campaign records.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: A utility class used to generate JavaScript code for form validation and other client-side interactions.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to validate required fields in a form before submission.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Creates an HTML form for entering a new campaign record, including JavaScript validation and default values.
